evals.prompt: Verify the migration of {SOURCE_URL} -- check redirects, content, and translations.
evals.expected_output: A structured Markdown report. The skill first loads project-config.md to resolve the source bases, destination base URL, drush runner, DB key, and (if defined) the scope/support table. It then runs Phase 0 (resolve intent), Phase 1 (redirect checks on the new site), Phase 2 (base-language content comparison via browser navigation), Phase 3 (translation checks for any non-base language defined in project-config), skips Phase 4 (non-migrate check does not apply to a migrate URL), and Phase 5 (structured report with the overall verdict). The report follows the single URL report format from the skill.
expectations: Report reads .agents/references/migrate/project-config.md before any verification step
Report resolves project-specific values (source bases, destination base URL, drush runner) from config rather than hardcoding them
Report follows the skill's phase-based structure (Phase 0 through Phase 5, with Phase 4 skipped for a migrate URL)
Report uses the scope/support table for intent only when project-config defines one, and otherwise derives intent without it
Report queries the source DB exclusively via the configured drush runner and drush sql:query, never the mysql client

evals.prompt: I need to verify that old pages marked as non-migrate are returning 410 Gone. Check {SOURCE_URL} on the new site.
evals.expected_output: A report covering Phase 0 (resolve intent showing the configured no-migrate status with expected code 410), Phase 4 (non-migrate HTTP check on the new site confirming the 410 response via the configured internal HTTP host), and Phase 5 (structured report with the overall verdict). It must NOT attempt content comparison or browser navigation for a non-migrate page.
expectations: Report identifies the URL as non-migrate using the action/status values defined in project-config
Report checks HTTP status via the configured internal HTTP host and confirms the expected Gone response
Report does NOT perform content comparison between old and new sites for a non-migrate page
Report produces a PASS verdict when the actual status matches the expected status

evals.prompt: Can you check if {SECONDARY_LANG_SOURCE_URL} was migrated correctly? I want to know if the content looks right and all the redirects work.
evals.expected_output: The skill handles a non-base-language source URL: it applies the language URL rule from project-config (separate domain or path prefix), resolves intent and the destination entity, checks redirects, navigates both the old and new pages for that language, compares content, and produces a structured report. This exercises the multilingual path of the workflow.
expectations: Report determines the language from the configured language URL rule (separate domain or path prefix) rather than assuming one
Report resolves the destination entity via the configured URL-map table or the scope-table final_url/node_id
Report checks language-specific redirects and HTTP statuses on the new site
Report flags a missing path alias or empty destination content as a FAIL with the root cause stated
Report follows the phase-based structure and overall verdict logic
